## What this changes



## Type
- [ ] Tool data (`data/overlay.json`)
- [ ] Stack preset (`data/stacks.json`)
- [ ] Site code / UI
- [ ] Build / CI / docs

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` run — generated files (`data/clis.json`, `data/meta.json`, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, SEO blocks) are committed
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (schema, cross-references, drift, links, HTML)
- [ ] Data changes cite the tool's own docs; nothing guessed
- [ ] `alternatives` / `related` reference slugs that exist
- [ ] Shipped site stays dependency-free (no new runtime `<script src>` beyond the allowed CDNs)
